items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m welcoming Jon Weber to campus. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: Jon was interviewed in Clinton, New York on June 2, 2012, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m welcoming Jon Weber to campus. Welcome, on our 200th Anniversary.
